Autoconfigure uses a small model of its own, Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, to read a model's card: which of its commands to use, and the advice it gives in prose. While it reads, whatever model is serving is stopped and then restarted. Without it, autoconfigure still uses the card's own command and this machine's cards.

The copy already installed is now the helper model.

Installed, 7.5 GB on disk.
